requirements.requirement: A systemd service named inventory-worker runs /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker on node1
requirements.summary: Unit file /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service was written with ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker, enabled and started via systemctl enable --now, and systemctl status confirms Active: active (running) with the correct binary as MainPID.

requirements.requirement: The service runs under a dedicated inventorysvc account
requirements.summary: A system account inventorysvc (uid 993, no home, /usr/sbin/nologin) was created and the unit specifies User=inventorysvc/Group=inventorysvc; ps confirms both the shell process and its sleep child are owned by inventorysvc.

requirements.requirement: Service configured on node1 (the only managed node)
requirements.summary: All commands were executed against node1, consistent with the managed topology listing node1 as the sole managed node.

overall_summary: The executor created the inventorysvc system account and an enabled/active inventory-worker.service running os-comparison-worker as that user on node1, satisfying the public task contract. It also completed the independent node-restart evidence protocol correctly: a healthy pre-restart baseline (boot_id 71f12f87..., service active/running) was captured, systemctl reboot was issued and a connection drop confirmed, and post-restart evidence shows a new boot_id (ecc8f58a...) matching the fixed after_executor snapshot, with the service active, enabled, and still running under inventorysvc. Lifecycle diffs show only expected reboot-related changes (new sshd PIDs, new /tmp systemd-private dirs) with no failed services or package-health issues.
limitations: The restart evidence relies on the executor's own captured boot_id and service status commands rather than an independently repeated probe beyond the fixed lifecycle snapshots, though the fixed after_prepare/after_executor boot-identity snapshots corroborate the transition.
The worker binary itself is a trivial sleep-loop stub (per cmd-84b3132d8c004c03), so functional correctness of 'os-comparison-worker' beyond process supervision cannot be assessed from evidence.

operational_hygiene.summary: Every state-changing command maps directly to the task: creating the inventorysvc account, writing/enabling the unit, and the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol (baseline capture, systemctl reboot, disconnect confirmation, post-reboot verification). No unnecessary mutations, abandoned files, or failed services are present; post-restart snapshot shows no failed-services and clean package health. Socket/PID and /tmp systemd-private directory changes between after_prepare and after_executor are expected reboot side effects, not executor residue.
